segments.name: U.S. Federal Services
segments.description: Serves U.S. federal agencies with program operations, clinical services and advanced technology solutions, including Medicare contact centers and veteran disability exams.
segments.evidence: Our U.S. Federal Services Segment delivers solutions that help various U.S. federal government agencies better execute on their mission, including program operations and management, clinical services, and advanced technology solutions.

segments.name: U.S. Services
products: Application assistance and independent health plan choice counseling
segments.description: Provides program operations, clinical assessments, employment services and technology solutions to U.S. state and local government programs.
segments.evidence: Our U.S. Services Segment provides a variety of services, such as program operations, clinical services, employment services and technology solutions and related professional services work for U.S. state and local government programs.

segments.name: Outside the U.S.
segments.description: Delivers employment and related government services outside the United States, including job placement and job retention outcome programs.
segments.evidence: Some of our contracts, notably our employment services contracts in the Outside the U.S. Segment, include payments for desired outcomes, such as job placement and job retention, and these outcome payments occur over several months.

revenueModel.text: Government agencies, mainly U.S. federal and state customers, pay Maximus fees for the services it provides under its contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue reflects fees earned for services provided.

changes.text: Maximus divested its Australian operations in fiscal year 2025.
changes.evidence: As a result of the divestiture of the our Australian operations in fiscal year 2025, the subsidiary loan agreement totaling $ 5.2 million as of September 30, 2024 was extinguished

changes.text: In November 2023 Maximus sold its businesses in Italy and Singapore and its employment services business in Canada.
changes.evidence: In November 2023, we sold our businesses in Italy and Singapore, as well as our employment services business in Canada, recording a loss on sale of $ 1.0 million.

changes.text: In March 2023 Maximus sold its commercial practice in the United Kingdom.
changes.evidence: In March 2023, we sold our commercial practice in the United Kingdom, resulting in a pre-tax loss of $ 0.6 million.
